NITI Aayog identifies TANE sector for GDP growth

NITI Aayog has stated that the TANE sector has the potential to double its share in India's GDP. The sector, described as the backbone of modern global connectivity, is currently at a critical juncture. Sharp trade imbalances highlight an urgent need for targeted policy support and intervention to foster its growth.
